display_information.name: Humagen
display_information.description: Your workspace's agents in Slack. Ask a question, build an agent, or review what one is waiting on.
display_information.long_description: Humagen brings your workspace's agents into Slack. Mention @Humagen in a channel, or send it a direct message, and the agent that fits the question answers. Answers cite the documents they came from. Before an agent posts a message, changes something or remembers something, it asks a person first. The Home tab shows what needs you, which agent answers your direct messages, and your connections. Agents only act as you through accounts you connected yourself.

shortcuts.name: Ask Humagen
shortcuts.description: Ask from anywhere. The answer arrives in the app's messages.

shortcuts.name: Ask Humagen about this
shortcuts.description: Answer in this message's thread, using the message as the question.

agent_view.agent_description: Your workspace's agents in Slack. Mention @Humagen or message it, and the agent that fits answers, with the documents it used. Agents ask a person before they post, change or remember anything.
